card.category: inference gateway, keyless free route, x402 pay-per-call for other models
card.summary: Requests with model auto/free and no credential are not billed and are rate limited per IP address in gateway calls per minute; no number is published

record.category: inference gateway, keyless free route, x402 pay-per-call for other models

free_tier.stated: Requests with model auto/free and no credential are not billed and are rate limited per IP address in gateway calls per minute; no number is published
free_tier.notes: auto/free routes to an open-weight model from a shared free pool, so the served model is chosen by the gateway; any other model answers HTTP 402 with a price quote in USDC

record.tooling: plain HTTP POST with no Authorization header; an OpenAI SDK always sends a key header, which the free route rejects with 401. CORS is allowed for browser use
record.chaining: pairs with prototypes that need a model to answer rather than a particular model; the paid route is an x402 wallet payment on Base or Solana

limits.value: unpublished: the page says the free route is rate limited per IP address, measured in gateway calls per minute, and gives no number

record.binding_note: the per-IP gateway-call ceiling is the only stated limit and its value is not published

identity_cost.detail: none for the free route: send no Authorization header at all; a placeholder key is rejected with 401, and no account or wallet is needed

record.reliability_note: the free models are served from a shared pool, so latency varies; GET /v1/models without a credential answers 401, so the catalogue is not open
record.confidence_note: the free route was not exercised: probe issues GET and HEAD only. A GET to /v1/models with no credential answered 401 Invalid token, and a GET to /v1/chat/completions answered 402 with a payment quote, so neither GET shows a completion

evidence.quote: Call a free LLM with one curl command: no API key, no account and no wallet. OpenAI-compatible, rate limited per IP, with paid models one 402 quote away.
evidence.proved: the free route needs no key, account or wallet and is rate limited per IP

evidence.quote: Send no Authorization header at all. The free tier admits only requests that carry no credential, and a placeholder key is rejected with 401.
evidence.proved: the free route admits only requests with no credential at all

evidence.quote: Rate limited per IP address, measured in gateway calls per minute.
evidence.proved: the only published limit is per IP address per minute, with no number

evidence.quote: auto/free routes to an open-weight model from the free pool. The response names the model that answered, so you can see which one you got.
evidence.proved: the model is chosen by the gateway and named in the response, so the requested id is not honoured as such
a keyless GET to /v1/models answered 401 Invalid token
a keyless POST on 2026-11-10 answered HTTP 402 with a payment quote, so no free route is served

record.notes: the echoed model on a completion was not observed; the page states the response names the model that answered
